title: Minimum Subsequence in Non-Increasing Order
goal: Choose the shortest subsequence whose sum exceeds the remaining values, preferring the greatest sum.
strategy: Taking largest values first maximizes the sum at each chosen length. The first prefix exceeding half the total has minimal length and maximal sum.
